text:
amy: Heads-up — seeing a provisioning spike in eu-west: ~40 nodes stuck in PXE after last night's UEFI patch. OOB shows SecureBoot=1 on machines that were previously 0. Anyone else?

deploy-bot: firmware-rollout: initiated UEFI update eu-west-3 at 2026-03-18T02:30Z; image=vendor-uefi-2.1.4

jon: Confirmed. I can repro for a handful of nodes in row B. BMC logs show the vendor flasher toggled the UEFI var `SecureBootEnable` during the flash.

sam: Are these dedicated pools or autoscale? Affected: gpu-pool-eu-west-3b, approx 42 nodes. Provisioning stuck at "Downloading bootx64.efi" then times out to a PXE blackhole.

amy: Working theory: vendor patch sets SecureBootEnable=1 when it can't find the cert db; firmware then rejects unsigned PXE binary and drops to a dead TFTP state. Also seeing BMC write rate limits triggering on some hosts.

maria: Dumped a BMC log from one affected node:```
Mar 18 02:31:12 bmc kernel: ipmi_smi: ipmi_smi_cmd_complete: 0x0
Mar 18 02:31:12 bmc fw: secureboot: var SecureBootEnable set -> 1
Mar 18 02:31:13 bmc net: tftp: read timeout
```

jon: Workaround is to set the UEFI var back to 0 via vendor IPMI util, but per-node is painfully slow. Can we mass-toggle via `racadm` or the vendor bulk API? Also we should bump BMC rate-limit to avoid session storms.

sam: I can run a job: `for node in $(cat list); do racadm -r $node set bios.uefi.SecureBootEnable 0; done` but racadm/telnet to chassis is limited to ~8 concurrent sessions so we need to stagger.

ops-runbook-bot: Runbook 7.2 'UEFI variable flip during firmware updates' recommends: 1) pause rollout, 2) apply var toggle, 3) reboot nodes, 4) verify PXE. https://runbooks/internal/uefi-flip

amy: Paused the rollout and flagged the dedicated-pool autoscaler. @oncall please reassign to eng-infra oncall.

jon: If mass toggle is slow, alternative is to enable "UEFI fallback signed mode" on the TFTP server so it serves a signed shim, but that's a larger blast radius. Prefer mass toggle + small pilot.

maria: Opening a vendor ticket — their flasher shouldn't change SecureBoot without enrolling certs. Attaching logs now.

sam: Starting a 5-node pilot using racadm at 02:45Z with 2s spacing; will report. If green, will ramp with 10s concurrency.

deploy-bot: firmware-rollout: paused by amy at 02:40Z. Current rollouts suspended.

sam: Pilot succeeded: nodes came back to PXE and completed provisioning. Commands used: `racadm set bios.uefi.SecureBootEnable 0; racadm jobqueue create bios; ipmitool chassis power cycle`. Proceeding with next batches at low concurrency.

amy: Nice work — keep me posted. After toggles finish, let's add a preflight check to the rollout to validate cert db presence and BMC write success. :eyes: 

jon: I'll add a preflight to the rollout manifest and a soft-fail if `SecureBootEnroll` is missing. Will open a PR for review.

maria: Also adding vendor ticket number VND-3829 and including the BMC dumps. We'll ask for a patch that avoids flipping SecureBoot when certs are absent. :thumbsup:
